title: Argentinian Beef Skewers with Chimichurri
description: Tender beef skewers grilled to perfection and served with a tangy Argentinian chimichurri sauce. Perfect for a summer evening.

ingredients.name: Skewers
ingredients.notes: Soak in water for 30 minutes before grilling

instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together garlic, red wine vinegar, and olive oil to make the chimichurri sauce.
3. Add the chopped parsley to the bowl and stir to combine.
4. Thread the beef cubes, red onion, and red bell pepper onto the skewers.
5. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
6. Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking.
7. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the beef is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
8. Serve the skewers hot with the chimichurri sauce and warm, buttery bread.
